title: Position fold over binary digits
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, scanning its symbols as recording-alphabet digit symbols with the position fold, starting from count zero and an initially true flag, returns the original word unchanged together with count $\min(2,|w|)$ and the assertion that the natural number encoded by $w$ in base two is zero.
